segments.text: Claude Code builds functional UIs that all look like they came from the same generic template. Awesome Design MD is a collection of plain text markdown files
capturing the exact design systems of 55 plus top tech companies. Stripe, Versel, linear, notion, Apple. Drop the design
MD for the aesthetic you want into your project route and your agent builds with their exact typography, hex codes, spacing, and component states.
